headline: A great catch by Kelce!
what_happened: P.Mahomes threw the ball to T.Kelce for a 16-yard gain, which gives the Chiefs a first down to keep their turn with the ball going.
why_it_matters: This is good news for the Chiefs as they lead 24 to 20, and this big play increased their chances of winning by 6 percentage points.
pop_culture: That is another catch for T.Kelce, who leads the team tonight with 9 catches for 101 yards.
